profiler.parserPath: retained structural profile generated with the complete PYTHON_MAP_PROFILE algorithm embedded in scripts/collect-ia-2012-precinct-geometry-diagnostic.mjs
profiler.executionNote: The retained profile was generated externally with the identical embedded algorithm because sandboxed Node execution cannot spawn Python; the profile and its source ledger are hash-gated before derived writes.

summary.bodyVintageClassifier: Exact extracted in-body statement: This map became effective January 15, 2012.

lexicalJoinDiagnostics.caveat: Feature-named OCG labels and text equality are useful diagnostics, but the large precinct geometry paths sit in generic precinct OCGs. No exact label result is treated as a stable feature ID or polygon assignment.

observedPaintedPathParity.caveat: Visual/path-count parity is not a feature identity or result assignment.

evidence: 48 of 52 retained PDFs expose vector path operators; 48 identify ArcMap as creator; 18 have geospatial viewports on every page. These are corpus counts, not blanket properties.
39 retained documents expose generic precinct optional-content layers and 39 expose feature-named precinct OCG labels; labels do not directly wrap the large geometry paths.
38 retained map documents explicitly state an effective date of January 15, 2012, before the November 6, 2012 election; 14 do not and are not classified as election-effective.
requiredConverterWork: Isolate generic precinct fill/boundary graphic-state operations from roads, cities, townships, labels, clipping paths, and other basemap content.
Apply page current-transformation matrices and /VP geospatial measurements where present to transform display-space paths.
Prefer higher-resolution city inset geometry over county-overview duplicates and de-duplicate overlapping representations.
Polygonize and topology-repair paths, then validate county coverage, gaps, overlaps, and expected feature counts.
Associate authoritative precinct labels/keys to polygons using reviewed OCG, label, or external county records; do not infer mappings from row order, counts, path color, or visual proximity.
conversionFeasibility.prototypeDecision: No polygon prototype is delivered in this package. A review-only converter is justified as separate work after cross-county structural consistency and authoritative label association are explicitly validated.

caveats: 52 of 99 systematically enumerated county map URLs returned PDFs; 47 redirect to the official unavailable page. Of the retained PDFs, 38 explicitly state the January 15, 2012 effective date and 14 do not.
HTTP Last-Modified dates in 2014 or later occur for 14 retained URLs: 1 have an explicitly dated body and 13 remain vintage-unproven. Headers alone do not establish election applicability.
4 retained PDFs have no extractable body text; their structure remains profiled, but their election vintage is unproven.
No picture-derived polygon, identifier, or result assignment is created.
